purpose: Separate land area from projected area
researchReuse: Read the sealed report and claim ledger for scope, version, evidence and limits; no fresh scientific or code experiment.
readingContext: Chinese native editable 16:9 slides; inspect all pages in PowerPoint.

composition.question: About fourteen times, not fourteen packed outlines
composition.relationship: The cited areas are 2,166,086 km² for Greenland and about 30,365,000 km² for Africa. They support a rounded ratio, not a claim that fourteen Greenland outlines fit inside Africa. The official Greenland PDF body was not verified.

composition.question: Equal longitude gaps are not equal ground distances
composition.relationship: Meridians converge on a sphere but stay equally spaced on a Mercator map. The map therefore stretches east-west distances more at high latitude. To preserve local angles, it stretches north-south distances by the same local factor.

composition.question: At 60°: twice in each direction, four times in area
composition.relationship: For a tiny patch in spherical Mercator with equatorial scale one, linear scale is sec(latitude) and area scale is its square. Greenland spans many latitudes: a local fourfold factor is not a whole-country multiplier.

composition.question: Move the land on a sphere, not by shrinking a picture
composition.relationship: Apply the same three-dimensional rotation to every boundary vertex. Spherical area stays unchanged while its outline on a fixed Mercator map changes. Natural Earth 1:110 million boundaries are generalized public-domain data, not precise survey measurements.

composition.question: Choose the property your question needs
composition.relationship: Mercator preserves local angles and draws constant-heading rhumb lines straight; they are usually not shortest routes. Its poles lie at infinity and must be cropped. Equal Earth preserves area proportions, but not every shape, angle or distance.
